**ShipmentTracker** — a Blazor Web App with **Interactive Auto** render mode (Server for fast first paint → WebAssembly for snappy client-side interaction).

### Architecture
| Layer | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **Render mode** | `InteractiveAuto` — SSR on first visit, then WASM takes over (no server round-trips) |
| **Auth** | ASP.NET Identity with **Dispatcher** and **Customer** roles |
| **Data** | EF Core + SQLite, `Shipment` entity with status/destination/ETA |
| **API** | Minimal API at `/api/shipments` — role-scoped (dispatchers see all, customers see theirs) |

### Pages
- **Home** (`/`) — landing page with role-aware navigation cards
- **Dispatcher** (`/dispatcher`) — full shipment table with filtering, status updates, and new shipment creation (Dispatcher role only)
- **My Shipments** (`/my-shipments`) — card-based view with progress bars and delivery estimates (any authenticated user)
- **Track** (`/track`) — tracking number lookup with visual progress stepper

### Demo Accounts
- **Dispatcher:** `dispatcher@shiptrack.com` / `Dispatch1!`
- **Customer:** `customer@example.com` / `Customer1!`

cd ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker && dotnet run
